progress.summary: S1-S8 are DONE. The backend has its foundation (local Node 24, embedded PostgreSQL with the full Docs/43 install, generated contract), the contract-driven request pipeline with all platform libraries and four deployables, identity + the auth server, billing and taxonomy, organizations, provider and vendor profiles, media (W6), vehicles, inventory, discovery, community, notifications, appointments, reviews and trust, and now fleets (assignments, approvals wired into issues/appointments/cost estimates, partners in search, reports, CSV exports W8 and imports W7), the admin plane on admin-api (aal3 staff, purpose-bound PII reads with audit, four-eyes changes, moderation with cases and an intake of held content, Path 2 reviewer decisions, disputes, badges, verification, locations, organization status/merge, billing, taxonomy with merge jobs, flags and kill switch, retention, audit search, MCP records, assist sessions), DSR execution (export bundle W8, deletion across modules in the worker) and product analytics (events.ingest → W12 pseudonymized → daily metrics → dashboards). 375 of 402 operations are implemented; 27 answer 501 (23 §21 AI operations for S9, 3 deferred S3 identity operations, and media.upload_put which is the storage listener's PUT). Next: S9 (AI/MCP facade, contract test sweep, OpenAPI, hardening). S9a is DONE: the AI facade and workers, WebAuthn, the media policy, one owner per VIN with transfers, and fleet data sharing (404 of 406 operations). S9b is DONE: the contract sweep (L22) — one generated suite per module from operations.json (pnpm contract:tests, checked by pnpm contract:check) with a hand-written resolver per operation, 457 HTTP routes swept for schema conformance, BOLA, same-organization BFLA, admin-plane mechanics, the kill switch and SEC-OUT-1 projections; it found and fixed a slug defect and tightened VinDecodeResult. S9c is DONE and with it S9 and the scratch build: shared/api-contracts/openapi.yaml (OpenAPI 3.1, generated from the registry, pnpm openapi:check against the registry and every host router), a GitHub Actions workflow (static checks + integration tests in lite mode), contract:coverage --strict with zero unexplained 501s (405/406 served; auth.social_start deferred post-MVP), fleet-driver visibility fixed (status history, fleet media, fleet AI records; sweep dimension added), a no-existence-oracle check of the non-404 BOLA refusals, risk_control_plan.json, the next_iteration list and the README. Next: the next_iteration list. On 2026-10-26 Docs/40 was raised to contract 1.1.0 (additive under TR-3) for gaps found by the consumer PWA (pwa/dev_plan.json DI-42..DI-46; backend DI-72, DI-73, DI-46): search facets, the soonest sort with a filled next_available_slot, the new search.session_get, search.page limit, MapPin profile fields and open_now on map.pins. The new stage S10 'PWA integration' implements it. Next: S10, then the next_iteration list. S10 is DONE (2026-10-26): contract 1.1.0 served — search.session_get (406/407 operations served), search facets, the soonest sort with next_available_slot, search.page limit and the map.pins changes; the 1.1.0 text was corrected before use (DI-74). Next: the next_iteration list; the PWA continues with P7 and adopts 1.1.0 in P14.

meta.purpose: Breaks the first (scratch) build of the CarPal backend into 9 stages, each sized to run in its own context window. Every stage writes its report back into this file so the next context can see what is done, what was decided and what to watch out for.
how_to_use: Start a new context with: 'Run stage <id> of backend/dev_plan.json'.
Read this file first: global_decisions, conventions, doc_issues, the reports of all completed stages, and handoff_notes. Then read only the doc sections listed in the stage's context_to_read.

Before starting, set the stage status to 'in_progress' and fill report.started_at. Update each task's status as you go (not_started | in_progress | done | deferred | blocked), so a context that runs out mid-stage can be resumed.

When finishing, fill the stage report (summary, ops_implemented, ops_deferred, deviations, notes_for_next), set status to 'done' (or 'partial' with reasons), append to handoff_notes and deviations_log, and update meta.last_updated.
Never delete earlier reports. Correct them by appending a note that says what changed.
If a stage changes a global decision, record it in global_decisions with the stage id and a reason. Do not edit the decision in place without a trace.
